plots.title: Validation loss and accepted checkpoint trace
plots.alt_text: Make the while-loop condition, sufficient-improvement branch, checkpoint snapshot and patience-triggered break visible alongside an epoch trace of current validation loss, accepted best loss, counter and retained checkpoint epoch. Suppose minimized validation values are 0.50, 0.44, 0.43 and 0.45, with min_delta 0.02 and patience 2. The move from 0.50 to 0.44 is sufficient improvement and resets the counter. The value 0.43 does not satisfy 0.43 < 0.44−0.02, so the counter becomes one; 0.45 makes it two and exhausts patience. The lowest observed value is 0.43, but the best checkpoint accepted under min_delta is the one at 0.44. Retain the 0.44 checkpoint’s weights, preserving them by deep copy or a saved state file. Bound the while loop by maximum epochs as well as the non-improvement rule. Protected-test observations do not decide patience or checkpoint choice.
plots.code:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
values = [0.5, 0.44, 0.43, 0.45]
min_delta = 0.02
patience = 2
best = float("inf")
counter = 0
accepted = []
counters = []
checkpoint_epoch = None
for epoch, value in enumerate(values, 1):
    if value < best - min_delta:
        best = value
        checkpoint_epoch = epoch
        counter = 0
    else:
        counter += 1
    accepted.append(best)
    counters.append(counter)
    if counter >= patience:
        break
epochs = list(range(1, len(accepted) + 1))
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 4.5))
ax.plot(epochs, values[:len(epochs)], marker="o", label="Current validation loss")
ax.step(epochs, accepted, where="post", label="Accepted checkpoint loss", linestyle="--")
ax.scatter([checkpoint_epoch], [best], marker="s", s=90, label="Retained checkpoint", zorder=4)
for epoch, value, count in zip(epochs, values, counters):
    ax.annotate(f"counter={count}", (epoch, value), xytext=(0, 12), textcoords="offset points", ha="center")
ax.set_xticks(epochs)
ax.set_xlabel("Epoch")
ax.set_ylabel("Validation loss (minimized)")
ax.set_title(f"min_delta={min_delta:g}; patience={patience}")
ax.margins(y=0.35)
ax.legend(loc="upper right")
fig.tight_layout()
